CustomField.formula: "Every " & IF(Interval__c = 1, "", TEXT(Interval__c) & " ") & CASE( TEXT(Frequency__c), "Daily", IF(Interval__c = 1, "day", "days"), "Weekly", IF(Interval__c = 1, "week", "weeks"), "Monthly", IF(Interval__c = 1, "month", "months"), "Yearly", IF(Interval__c = 1, "year", "years"), "" )
CustomField.label: Schedule Description
